coverage: Top-level public catalogue groups observed on the review date, not a complete installed export manifest. Compound subcomponents are documented by their parent.
apiEvidence: Official catalogue and facebook/astryx sources, including v0.6.1 Banner/DateTimeInput source URLs. Corrected Banner to endContent and reused MetadataListItem. npm dependencies and exact installed package types/CLI/rendering remain unverified. 0.11 source review includes pinned NumberInput and Selector signatures for staged soundtrack/style controls; no installed-package assertion. 0.12 reviews pinned Table/NumberInput and Button documentation for composition; installed CLI remains unavailable and packageVerified stays false. 0.13 reuses existing source-reviewed selectors/tables/sections for independent-layer and STT review. Installed CLI discovery was attempted again but is unavailable; no real installed UI/type or visual approval. 0.14 reuses source-reviewed CheckboxInput(value/onChange), RadioList and TextInput for translation review/rules; pinned 0.6.1 sources checked. CLI remains absent, packageVerified false, no loaded visual/IME acceptance.

AppShell.reason: One persistent desktop frame, main landmark and library-managed responsive navigation; avoids a second hand-built shell.

SideNav.reason: Five product areas with selected and unavailable states; navigation is not represented by a random collection of action buttons.

Button.reason: Explicit import, save, render, retry and cancellation commands; preserve descriptive text and limit primary emphasis per task.

Toolbar.reason: Related editing commands form a named keyboard-navigable toolbar; do not place arbitrary forms under roving arrow navigation.

Section.reason: Flat page regions for editor tools and automation forms; these are not discrete cards, so repeated Card nesting is inappropriate.

Layout.reason: VStack/HStack compose actual related controls with library spacing; preserve specialized editor split geometry in layout CSS.

TextInput.reason: Find/replace editable strings. Library owns labels, focus and input semantics; data transformations remain in the subtitle module.

TextArea.reason: Multiline bilingual cue text must remain directly editable, retaining caret, selection and IME behavior.

NumberInput.reason: Precise numeric media offsets, sampling intervals and normalized regions; not wall-clock time, so TimeInput is unsuitable.

Selector.reason: Compact selection among language labels; UI locale and OCR content language use separate domain state.

RadioList.reason: Keep folder first-run scope, manual/automatic masks, reference/copy storage and reuse/separate duplicates visible before submission; these choices change execution or disk usage.

CheckboxInput.owner: folder drafts and Library page selection
CheckboxInput.reason: Folder recursion is committed on Save, while Library row and indeterminate page selection only stage explicit actions; neither implies immediate processing.

Table.reason: Time-aligned cues, queued jobs and folder routes need column comparison and per-row actions; not a decorative card grid.

AlertDialog.reason: Explicit confirmation before replacing user-authored subtitle content or discarding edits; maintain focus and cancellation.

Banner.reason: Persistent contextual failure, unavailable-model, stale-result and recovery information; not fleeting Toast-only errors.

EmptyState.reason: Genuinely empty datasets get a specific explanation and useful next step; never display emptiness while loading or in error.

Badge.reason: Only short exceptional states needing attention, such as failed/interrupted jobs or stale drafts. Counts and normal states stay plain text.

Collapsible.owner: batch, OCR evidence, Library identity and advanced settings
Collapsible.reason: Optional queue details and verbose OCR observations can be disclosed without cancelling host-owned work; required controls stay visible.

ProgressBar.owner: render, vision, file intake and model configuration
ProgressBar.reason: Display measured worker fractions, or an explicitly indeterminate state. Never manufacture a percentage or leave completed jobs animating.

Divider.reason: A themed separator between draft admission and persisted queue, not a custom decorative rule.

i18n.reason: One internationalization provider tracks UI language and library message overrides independently of content and processing languages.

theme.reason: One neutral dark theme supplies library appearance; app styles own geometry and do not redefine component internals.

TabList.reason: Library and Downloads are peer views inside Sources. Controlled TabList with role=tablist, stable Tab IDs and panelId owns keyboard selection; it does not trigger downloads.

MetadataList.reason: Read-only source paths, related provenance and runtime/model facts are labelled values, not editable text fields or decorative metric cards. MetadataList preserves this distinction.

MultiSelector.reason: Explicit many-to-many shared label assignment and optional post links with searchable selections, not unrelated checkbox walls or invented product matching.

FormLayout.reason: Group name and identity fields for explicit Save forms without implying a sequential stepper or auto-saving switch behavior.

DateTimeInput.reason: Choose a real calendar date and wall-clock time for a local post plan; pair with timezone validation and explicit repeated-hour disambiguation. Never used for media duration.
